The embalming table allows you to use various embalming fluids on a {{item|corpse}} or on a {{item|zombie}} to change their properties. Those fluids are prepared on the [[church workbench]] and require {{item|water}} and {{item|conical flasks}} to be prepared, as well as various [[alchemy|alchemical]] elements.  Therefore, it is not necessary to build this table before learning how to [[Smithing (Tech Tree)|smelt glass]] and to [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|build alchemical workstations]].

When placing a [[corpse]] on an embalming table, their decay is slowed down (tier 1) or stopped completely (tier 2). Each embalming table increases the {{Morgue Capacity}} by one. For more information about how corpse rating works, see [[corpse]]s; for more information about preparing bodies, see the [[morgue]].

Each injection type can only be used once per corpse, but similar types will stack.

==Recipes==
To use the table, you place a body on it and add the injection into the crafting window. The craft is automatic and takes 1 minute and 30 seconds in game (only when time is not paused) to complete. Each type of injection can only be used once per corpse.

'''Note:''' Fluids that reduce the amount of {{Skull|Red}} , like silver and gold injections, need the corresponding red skulls to be present in the corpse; otherwise they can't be applied. In this case, remove some body parts on a [[preparation place]] first that increase the number of {{Skull|Red}} and apply the injection afterwards.

Note: Skull count can be negative, meaning that if you have 11 white skulls, and -1 or less red skulls, you can use the lye injection to add a white skull, making it possible to add a total of +7 white skulls through preparation and embalming.
